limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also added reset gating and replaced the original pointer and flag logic, changing the cycles on which `wfull` and `rempty` update.
The scoreboard checked data on transfers admitted by the DUT’s own flags, so it could pass without detecting that the flags admitted transfers on different cycles than the original design.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire test invocation to be rejected before simulation, so the agent had to submit the test again.
The agent repeated a successful compile after adding only a comment, without adding any behavioral coverage.
